COMPLICATIONS OF FALLS
Complications
Economic
Costs of:
- Disability
- Dependence
- Hospitalization and interventions to treat Complications

Physical:
- Dehydration,
- Dependency,
- Disability and Fractures,
- Haemorrhage e.g. subdural haematoma
- Hypothermia
- Immobility
- Increased likelihood of falling again
- Self-imposed reduction in physical activity
- Severe injuries requiring hospitalization and Skin lacerations

Psychological
- Anxiety
- Depression
- Fear of falling; falls phobia syndrome
- Loss of confidence
- Social withdrawal
